privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This page explains which personal data Griot collects, what they are used for, how long they are kept and who receives them.
privacy.draft.title: Draft under review
privacy.draft.body: This text is a draft: it still has to be checked by a competent person and it may change.
privacy.controller.heading: Who handles the data
privacy.controller.missing_name: [Name of the controller to be added]
privacy.controller.providers: Each professional on Griot receives the data of the bookings made with them and uses them to manage those bookings. Their role regarding these data still has to be set out in this notice.
privacy.data.heading: Which data we collect
privacy.data.customers: Your name, phone number, email if you leave it, the notes you write, the language you use the site in, and the day and time of the booking, with the service you chose.
privacy.data.customers_by_provider: A booking can also be entered by the professional, with the same details.
privacy.data.providers: The account details (name, email, language and the password, stored in a form that cannot be read back) and the profile details you choose to add: business name, city, description, WhatsApp number, Instagram profile and photo. A published profile can be seen by everyone.
privacy.data.technical: To make the site work we store a session, with the IP address and the type of browser (user agent). The IP address is also used to limit requests that come too often.
privacy.purpose.heading: What they are used for
privacy.purpose.customers: The details of the person booking are used to send the booking request to the professional, to let them confirm, decline or cancel it, and to tell you their answer: by email, if you left one, or on WhatsApp, if the professional uses it.
privacy.purpose.providers: The professionals' details are used to manage the account and to show the public profile.
privacy.purpose.technical: The technical data are used to keep you logged in, to protect the forms and to limit abuse.
privacy.purpose.no_marketing: The site does not use the data for advertising or for analytics tools.
privacy.retention.heading: How long they are kept
privacy.retention.bookings: The name, phone, email and notes of the person booking, together with the reason for any cancellation, are made anonymous :months months after the end of the booking, or after its start if the booking request never got an answer. Only the details that do not identify you remain, such as the service and the date.
privacy.retention.providers: The account and profile details are kept as long as the account exists.
privacy.retention.technical: The session expires after :minutes minutes without activity and is then deleted.
privacy.recipients.heading: Who receives the data
privacy.recipients.provider: The professional you choose, who sees the name, phone, email and notes to manage the booking.
privacy.recipients.whatsapp: WhatsApp, if the professional chooses to write to you there: the message contains your name, the booking details and the link to its page.
privacy.recipients.hosting: The hosting service that runs the site and the database.
privacy.recipients.email: The email delivery service, for the emails about the booking and the account.
privacy.recipients.no_one_else: The data are not passed on to others for advertising.
privacy.rights.heading: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You can ask to see your data, to correct them or to delete them, and you can object to their use. To do so, write to the address given under contacts.
privacy.rights.providers: Professionals can also change their account and profile details from their own area.
privacy.rights.authority: You can also contact the data protection authority.
privacy.contact.heading: Contacts
privacy.contact.body: For questions about this notice or about your data, write to
privacy.cookies.heading: Cookies
privacy.cookies.intro: The site only uses the cookies it needs to work and to remember your choices. It does not use analytics, advertising or third-party cookies.
privacy.cookies.name: Name
privacy.cookies.session: Keeps the session and the login to the professionals' area.

privacy.cookies.locale: Remembers the language you chose. It is only stored when you choose a language.
privacy.cookies.appearance: Remembers the light or dark theme. It is stored on the first visit, even without a choice.
privacy.cookies.sidebar: Remembers whether the side menu of the professionals' area is open or closed.
privacy.cookies.storage: The chosen theme is also stored in the browser storage (localStorage), until you clear it.
